response:
The angular half-width at half maximum (HWHM) of the Fabry-Perot fringe at an angle of 1° is computed using the formula \(\Delta\theta = \frac{\lambda(1-R)}{4\pi L \sin\theta \sqrt{R}}\). With \(L = 5\ \text{cm}\), \(\lambda = 0.6\ \mu\text{m}\), \(\theta = 1^\circ\), and \(R = 0.98\), this gives \(\Delta\theta \approx 1.105 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{rad}\).

The depth of focus for a \(2\times\) magnifying glass (or eyepiece) is the range of object distances that yield a clear image when the eye accommodates from infinity to the near point (25 cm). With focal length \(f = 25\ \text{cm} / 2 = 12.5\ \text{cm}\), the depth is \(f^2/(f + 25\ \text{cm}) = 156.25 / 37.5 \approx 4.1667\ \text{cm}\).

ANSWER: 1.105e-6,4.1667
